annotation_rule: Inspect RGB image and 2D boxes only. Mark the uniquely paired cup/mug and table true if the child visibly rests on the table, false if visibly elsewhere, null if contact cannot be judged. Save labels before looking at depth predictions or 3D references.
support_proposal: Unchanged cup/mug footpoint inside surface box and predicted median depth gap <=0.75 m; no tuning on this sample.
primary_metric: mean child 3D centroid error in metres on visually positive pairs using oracle 2D boxes, comparing weighted, hard, and uncorrected predictions
secondary_metrics: same centroid error for automatic matched pairs, with unmatched positives counted as missing coverage
claim_limits: SUN RGB-D training split complement of official test images; no parameter changes after unblinding. Small convenience subset with possible room correlations. Oracle intrinsics and a hand-set 0.4m offset prior. Do not claim uncertainty-weighting novelty unless it beats exact contact.
